title: Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Amendment Rules, 2026
summary: MeitY amended the IT Rules, 2021 to cover 'synthetically generated information': audio, visual or audio-visual content created or altered by computer so that it appears real, with exclusions for routine edits and accessibility uses. Notified on 10 February 2026 after an October 2025 draft, the rules took effect on 20 February 2026. Intermediaries offering such tools must label synthetic content prominently, embed provenance metadata that cannot be removed, and block certain unlawful content. Significant social media intermediaries must collect and verify user declarations on whether uploads are synthetic. Deadlines for acting on government or court orders fall from 36 hours to 3 hours, and to 2 hours for non-consensual intimate imagery.
key_obligations: Embed permanent provenance metadata or identifiers in synthetic content
Significant social media intermediaries must obtain and verify user declarations
Act on government or court takedown orders within three hours
Remove non-consensual intimate imagery within two hours

sources.title: India introduces mandatory labelling for AI and 3-hour takedown for illegal content
MeitY notifies the IT Amendment Rules 2026
MeitY closes consultation on draft IT Rules amendment addressing synthetically generated information
